exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.description: The bench press is a compound exercise primarily targeting the chest, shoulders, and triceps. It involves lying on a bench and pressing a barbell or dumbbells upward. Proper form includes keeping the feet flat on the ground, maintaining a neutral spine, and controlling the weight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Incline bench press
exercises.description: Bench press on a 30-45 degree incline; shifts emphasis to the upper chest and front delts.

exercises.name: Decline bench press
exercises.description: Bench press on a decline bench; emphasises the lower chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.description: Flat bench press with dumbbells; longer range of motion and independent arms.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.description: Dumbbell press on an incline bench for the upper chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, open the arms wide with a slight elbow bend and squeeze them back together.

exercises.name: Cable crossover
exercises.description: Standing between two high pulleys, bring the handles together in front of the chest.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.description: Seated machine press; a stable way to train the chest close to failure.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: From a plank, lower the chest to the floor and press back up keeping the body straight.

exercises.name: Chest dip
exercises.description: Dip on parallel bars with a forward lean to bias the chest.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: The deadlift is a compound exercise that targets the posterior chain, including the hamstrings, glutes, and lower back. It involves lifting a barbell from the ground to hip level while maintaining a neutral spine. Proper form includes engaging the core, keeping the bar close to the body, and controlling the weight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.description: The barbell row is a compound exercise targeting the back muscles, particularly the lats, traps, and rhomboids, with variations affecting bicep and rear delt activation. It involves hinging at the hips and pulling a barbell towards the torso. Proper form includes maintaining a straight back, engaging the core, and controlling the weight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull the chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.description: Pull-up with an underhand grip; more biceps involvement.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.description: Seated, pull the bar to the upper chest, driving the elbows down.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.description: Seated, pull the handle to the stomach keeping the torso upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.description: One hand and knee on a bench, row the dumbbell to the hip.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.description: Row a landmine-loaded bar to the chest with a hinged torso.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.description: Pull a rope at face height towards the forehead, elbows high; rear delts and upper back.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at the sides and elevate the shoulders straight up; trapezius.

exercises.name: Back extension
exercises.description: On a hyperextension bench, hinge at the hips and raise the torso; lower back and glutes.

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.description: The shoulder press is a compound exercise that targets the shoulders, triceps, and upper chest. It involves pressing a barbell or dumbbells overhead while standing or seated. Proper form includes keeping the core engaged, maintaining a neutral spine, and controlling the weight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.description: Seated or standing, press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.description: Dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing you to facing forward on the way up.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height; side delts.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.description: Single-arm lateral raise from a low pulley; constant tension.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height; front delts.

exercises.name: Reverse fly
exercises.description: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells out to the sides; rear delts.

exercises.name: Upright row
exercises.description: Pull a barbell up along the body to chest height, elbows leading.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.description: Standing, curl the bar from the thighs to the shoulders keeping the elbows still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.description: Curl dumbbells with palms up, alternating or together.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.description: Curl with palms facing each other; biceps and brachialis.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.description: Curl over a preacher bench to remove momentum.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.description: Curl a bar or rope from a low pulley.

exercises.name: Tricep pushdown
exercises.description: Push a rope or bar down from a high pulley, elbows pinned to the sides.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
exercises.description: Lying, lower an EZ bar to the forehead by bending the elbows, then extend.

exercises.name: Overhead tricep extension
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head and extend.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.description: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip; triceps emphasis.

exercises.name: Tricep dip
exercises.description: Dip with an upright torso to bias the triceps.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.description: The squat is a compound exercise that targets the quadriceps, hamstrings, glutes, and lower back. It involves bending at the knees and hips to lower the body while keeping the chest up and back straight. Proper form includes maintaining a neutral spine, keeping the knees aligned with the toes, and controlling the weight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.description: Squat with the bar racked on the front of the shoulders; upright torso, quad emphasis.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.description: Squat holding a dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.description: Seated, press the platform away by extending the knees and hips.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.description: Seated, extend the knees against the pad; isolates the quads.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Rear foot elevated on a bench, squat down on the front leg.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.description: Step forward into a lunge, alternating legs as you walk.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.description: Squat on a hack squat machine with the back supported.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge at the hips with soft knees, lowering the bar along the legs; hamstrings and glutes.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.description: Curl the pad towards the glutes by bending the knees; isolates the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.description: Bar on the back, hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and return.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.description: Upper back on a bench, drive the hips up with a bar across them.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.description: Lying on your back, drive the hips up by squeezing the glutes.

exercises.name: Cable kickback
exercises.description: Kick one leg back against a low pulley ankle strap.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.description: Rise onto the toes against resistance, pause, lower under control.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.description: Seated calf raise; targets the soleus.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight-body position on forearms and toes. Log reps as seconds held.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Lying, curl the shoulders towards the hips.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.description: Hanging from a bar, raise the legs to hip height or higher.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.description: Kneeling, crunch down against a rope on a high pulley.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.description: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso side to side.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.description: Kneeling, roll the wheel forward as far as you can control, then pull back.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.description: Hinge and snap the hips to swing the kettlebell to chest height.

exercises.name: Clean and press
exercises.description: Pull the bar from the floor to the shoulders, then press it overhead.

exercises.name: Farmer's walk
exercises.description: Walk while holding heavy weights at your sides; grip and core.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: Squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. Conditioning.
